global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with tender chashu pork and crisp menma, alongside a single nori sheet. Served in a white bowl with green patterns, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain pattern, and subtle natural texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with green geometric and floral patterns, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy white, thick, and glossy, swirling around golden noodles with visible green garnish flecks.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, slightly curled, with a rough, textured surface and visible veins.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced, with marbled fat and light brown color, showing slight sheen and soft texture.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly curled, fibrous strips with visible texture and irregular edges.
